chunks: Indeed the ledger of the wicked will be in (the lowest depths) Sijjin.

key_terms.الْفُجَّارِ: The wicked, transgressors, or those who exceed bounds
key_terms.سِجِّينٍ: Sijjin, a low register or place of record for the wicked

ai.seo_question: What is Sijjin and where is the book of the wicked placed according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Sijjin' is often interpreted not merely as a physical location but as the spiritual repository of the wicked, reflecting their inner corruption and lowly status before Allah. This verse serves as a direct counterpart to the record of the righteous in 'Illiyyin,' emphasizing the cosmic duality of reward and punishment in the afterlife. The term 'Fujjar' specifically denotes those who transgress moral boundaries, a concept deeply explored in Shia hadith regarding the deeds of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers.
